newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia awards Mobil oil, gas search permits.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia awards Mobil oil, gas search permits.

text.p: Tunisia has granted an exploration permit to Mobil Corp to search for oil and gas in the south of the country, an official at Mobil Tunisie said on Thursday.
The permit covers a 3,168 sq km area called Ghomrassen in the region of Tataouine, southern Tunisia.

The agreement was signed in Tunis on Wednesday by Industry Minister Slaheddine Bougerra, the chairman of Entreprise Tunisienne d'Activites Petrolieres (ETAP) Mohamed Moncef Boussen, and Pamela Luttrell, chairwoman of Mobil Exporting and Production, Tunisia (MEPT).
The Mobil Tunisie official said MEPT had been set up specifically to carry out the exploration.
